The core contributions address the "black box within a black box" problem by trading pure pixel-minimality for semantic transparency. The method demonstrates strong empirical results: concept attribution aligns with actual changes (Fig 7), and using concept-based targets significantly improves flip ratios and FID compared to the baseline LDCE (Table 1). The work is built on a solid theoretical foundation (gradient-based concept selection) and tested across multiple architectures (VGG, ResNet, ViT).
